name: observability-tool-cost-and-overlap-reporter
description: Finds services instrumented in more than one paid telemetry or APM tool (CloudWatch, Datadog, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, New Relic), estimates the licence and ingest waste that overlap represents, and recommends a consolidation target per service. Dollar figures are estimates; Cost Explorer and vendor billing are authoritative. Read-only.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on MON at 08:15 UTC
